summary: The current UI implementation diverges significantly from DESIGN.md. The most critical failure is that DashboardScreen is completely empty, so the primary flow never reaches the required empty‑state "Nothing here yet" and blocks the user. Many other screens lack required states, copy, or interaction details (e.g., PolicyGate error view, Receipts/Mileage empty‑state copy, focus‑visible styles, proper touch‑target sizes). Design tokens are not consistently used, and accessibility landmarks and focus handling are missing in several components. Navigation to primary actions is incomplete, and several UI components do not meet the 44×44 dp touch‑target or focus‑visible requirements. These issues together prevent a polished, accessible product and break the primary user flow.

findings.issue: The file is empty – no UI is rendered. All required states (loading, empty, populated, error) are missing, so the dashboard never shows the "Nothing here yet" EmptyState, breaking the primary flow.
findings.fix: Implement DashboardScreen per DESIGN.md: show a centered ActivityIndicator while loading, render the EmptyState component with the exact title/description/button when there are no entries, display SummaryCards and recent activity when data exists, and provide an error view with a Retry button.

findings.issue: Error handling UI is not present – the spec requires a full‑screen error view with a Retry button when storing policy acceptance fails, but the component lacks this state.
findings.fix: Add an error state that displays the message "Unable to store your acceptance. Please try again." and a Retry button that re‑attempts the store operation.

findings.issue: EmptyState copy does not match the spec (title/description and primary button label). The current implementation uses generic text, causing a mismatch with the required "No receipts recorded" and "Add receipt".
findings.fix: Update the EmptyState component usage to use the exact title "No receipts recorded", description "Tap the + button to add your first receipt.", and primary button label "Add receipt".

findings.issue: EmptyState copy is incorrect – the spec expects title "No mileage logged" and button "Add mileage" but the implementation differs.
findings.fix: Adjust the EmptyState component to use the exact copy defined in DESIGN.md.

findings.issue: Focus‑visible styling is missing. The spec requires a 2 dp outline using theme.colors.outline when the button receives keyboard focus, which is not implemented.
findings.fix: Add a focusVisible style that applies a 2 dp outline with color theme.colors.outline and ensure it works on web.

findings.issue: Mini‑FAB touch target is 40×40 dp, below the required minimum 44×44 dp touch area, potentially causing accessibility issues.
findings.fix: Wrap the MiniFAB icon in a TouchableOpacity with at least 44×44 dp hitSlop or increase the touchable area to meet the minimum size.

findings.issue: Numeric fields (amount, miles) lack appropriate keyboardType and autocomplete attributes, reducing usability. Validation helper texts are present but no on‑field focus management on error.
findings.fix: Set keyboardType="numeric" for numeric inputs, add appropriate autocomplete (e.g., autocomplete="off"), and ensure the first invalid field receives focus programmatically when validation fails.

findings.issue: Hard‑coded color values (e.g., '#0061A4') are used instead of the theme tokens, violating the design‑token requirement.
findings.fix: Replace any literal color codes with references to theme.colors (e.g., theme.colors.primary, theme.colors.onPrimary).

findings.issue: Horizontal padding is applied as a static 16 dp value rather than using the theme spacing unit (theme.spacing * 2).
findings.fix: Use the design token: const horizontalPadding = theme.spacing * 2; and apply it to the Screen component's container style.

findings.issue: Bottom navigation lacks proper ARIA landmarks and explicit role="navigation"; also the bar may not be anchored to the bottom on web, breaking the phone‑first layout on larger viewports.
findings.fix: Add accessibilityLabel="Bottom navigation" and role="navigation" to the BottomTabBar, and ensure its style includes position: absolute; bottom: 0; width: 100% on all platforms.

findings.issue: Dialog actions do not have a visible focus outline, missing the required focus‑visible style for keyboard navigation.
findings.fix: Apply a focusVisible style (2 dp outline using theme.colors.outline) to the Dialog's action buttons.

findings.issue: EmptyState illustration lacks an accessibilityLabel (alt text) for screen readers.
findings.fix: Add an accessibilityLabel="Empty state illustration" to the illustration component.

findings.issue: Header does not use the appropriate heading level (h1) semantics – it renders as a regular Text component without role="heading".
findings.fix: Wrap the title in <Text variant="headlineMedium" accessibilityRole="header"> to provide correct heading semantics.

findings.issue: The 'Accept' button is grayed out until the checkbox is checked, which is correct behavior, but the placeholder text 'Tick the box to continue.' is redundant since the button state visually communicates this.
findings.fix: Remove the placeholder text below the button for cleaner visual hierarchy.

findings.issue: The checkbox and 'Accept' button are centered within a rounded container, but the container’s width is not optimized for the phone viewport; it could be slightly narrower to better utilize the available space.
findings.fix: Adjust the container width to be more tightly aligned with the content, reducing wasted space.

findings.issue: The screen is entirely blank — no UI elements, text, or layout visible. This is not a usable or functional screen.
findings.fix: Implement the defined empty state: show title 'Nothing here yet', description 'Add a receipt or mileage entry to start tracking your finances.', and a primary button 'Add receipt'.

findings.issue: The screen is entirely blank — no UI elements, text, or layout visible. This is not a usable or functional screen.
findings.fix: Implement the defined empty state: show title 'Nothing here yet', description 'Add a receipt or mileage entry to start tracking your finances.', and a primary button 'Add receipt'.

findings.issue: visual quality 1/10 on 'dashboard - empty' (target 8+, minimum 7): The screen is completely blank — no UI elements, no text, no layout, no visual hierarchy. This is not a functional or usable screen. It violates every design principle: no primary action, no typography, no spacing, no grouping, no color, no form, no navigation, no empty state guidance, and no touch-friendly controls. It is unstyled, unpolished, and unusable.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.
